title: Occupancy Loading on Summit Reserve Hazard Renewals
content:
A home that is empty or not lived in by the borrower renews its hazard cover at different rates. For a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve under Set-Aside Accounts, the hazard occupancy loading reads the occupancy profile (Occupancy and Residency Certification) of the reserve's Summit loan and the loan's maturity case (Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases).

| Occupancy profile | Maturity case | Hazard occupancy loading |
|---|---|---|
| Closed | Death of Last Surviving Borrower, due and payable or in its extension period | Vacant-home loading, 10.0 percent — a home left empty after the last borrower's death renews at unoccupied rates |
| Non-occupancy confirmed | Any | Absence loading, 5.0 percent |
| Health-care absence under monitoring | Any | Absence loading, 5.0 percent |
| Closed, with any other maturity situation; or any other status | — | None under this rule |

The first row needs both parts: a closed profile alone, or a death case not yet due and payable or in extension, does not give the vacant-home loading.
